task: Derive canonical release-unit child proof routes from direct Atlas proof plus regression tests of the unit's currently applicable Known Failures, and bind that same proof set into manifest required evidence without widening material scope.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Live bounded rehearsal replay after PR #1009 reached fresh child-plan reprojection successfully, but U01 remained blocked because a fixture-only critical child had MUST_CREATE, AUTHORITY and UNKNOWN=[] while Atlas direct routing found no proof edge. The Knowledge system already selects applicable Known Failures and their regressionTests for Incremental Replay, but Plan/release-unit projection does not currently reuse that machine-authoritative proof surface.
observableOutcomes: Canonical child proof equals direct semantic proof union regressionTests of currently applicable Known Failures.
The same canonical proof set is written to semanticExecutionRoute.proof and manifest requiredEvidence.proofFiles.
Fresh child reprojection rebuilds proof from current projected scope, allowing persisted fixture/config/data-only children to recover after policy evolution.
Proof files remain read-only evidence and never widen the child intendedFiles/material operation set.
If direct proof plus Known Failure regression proof is still empty for a critical child, strict Plan validation remains fail-closed.
unresolvedRisks: Using all repository tests rather than only applicable Known Failure tests would over-broaden proof authority.
Updating route.proof but not manifest requiredEvidence would create two conflicting evidence identities.
Proof paths must not leak into intendedFiles or release operations.
Template Factory Known Failures must use the same canonical getAllFailures registry as Incremental Replay.
Fresh reprojection must refresh proof identity and binding digest consistently.

in: Reuse getAllFailures and resolveDevelopmentScope as canonical Known Failure applicability sources.
Derive deterministic regression proof files from activeFailureIds.
Use direct Atlas/skeleton proof union Known Failure regression proof for top-level child projection and initial release-unit child binding.
Expose the proof set in childPlanProjection and bind it to requiredEvidence.proofFiles during reprojection.
Add regression proof for fixture-only critical child fallback, exact proof union and non-widening material scope.
out: No proof path added to intendedFiles or operations.
No weakening of critical semantic route validation.
No manual state reset, PR creation, merge receipt or closure fabrication.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This changes proof authority derivation for write-capable release execution. The fallback must be machine-derived, scope-bounded, deterministic and incapable of widening material release scope.

acceptanceCriteria: A helper derives regression proof paths from only the current activeFailureIds and getAllFailures registry.
Top-level childPlanProjection semantic route proof is direct proof union applicable Known Failure regression tests.
Root release-unit decomposition uses the same proof union for semanticExecutionRoute.proof and requiredEvidence.proofFiles.
reprojectReleaseUnitChildTransaction updates requiredEvidence.proofFiles from the projection and recomputes manifest/binding identity.
Proof fallback does not alter intendedFiles or operations.
Critical child with no direct proof but applicable Known Failure regression tests passes semantic route completeness; no-proof after both sources remains BLOCK.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle close before merge; the unchanged rehearsal is replayed from its persisted STALE state.
invariants: Proof fallback is derived only from canonical current Known Failure applicability.
Proof files are evidence, not material scope.
Route proof and manifest requiredEvidence proof remain identical after projection/reprojection.
No release unit becomes executable solely because diagnostics were parsed or manually patched.
Existing Plan, Atlas, Release Risk, CAS, exact PR identity, Truth and Lifecycle authority remain unchanged.

failureModes: Fixture/config/data child has no Atlas direct test edge.
Known Failure proof derivation accidentally includes non-applicable failures.
Route proof is refreshed but manifest required evidence remains stale.
Proof files are mistakenly added to release operations.
Template Factory regression tests are omitted because only global registry is consulted.
edgeCases: Direct proof exists and Known Failure proof adds additional tests.
Direct proof is empty but Known Failure regression proof is non-empty.
Multiple active failures reference the same regression test.
Critical child has no direct or Known Failure proof and must remain blocked.
Persisted child is reprojected under a changed Known Failure registry.

alternatives.summary: Use direct semantic proof union regressionTests for current applicable Known Failures.
alternatives.reason: This is already the repository's canonical Incremental Replay proof authority and remains scope-bounded.

alternatives.summary: Copy every parent proof route into every child.
alternatives.reason: Could assign proof unrelated to the child scope and may reference proof staged in a later release unit.

alternatives.summary: Use guard IDs as semantic route proof entries.
alternatives.reason: Semantic route proof represents concrete proof surfaces; guard obligations already have a separate gate-chain contract.

alternatives.summary: Allow critical fixture children with an empty proof route.
alternatives.reason: Would weaken the assurance contract instead of closing the missing evidence edge.

specialistReviews.finding: The missing edge is between canonical Known Failure applicability and semantic child proof routing, not between decomposition and material operations.
specialistReviews.resolution: Derive one canonical proof set from direct route plus applicable failure regression tests and reuse it across child route and manifest evidence.

specialistReviews.finding: A generic proof fallback could silently broaden authorization if it adds arbitrary tests or converts proof files into material scope.
specialistReviews.resolution: Select only regressionTests attached to current activeFailureIds and assert intendedFiles/operations remain unchanged.

specialistReviews.finding: Route proof and manifest requiredEvidence must remain the same identity input across fresh reprojection.
specialistReviews.resolution: Carry canonical proof in child projection and update requiredEvidence.proofFiles before refreshReleaseUnitIdentity.

specialistReviews.finding: Incremental Replay already resolves activeFailureIds to regressionTests with getAllFailures, providing the canonical source needed by fixture-only children.
specialistReviews.resolution: Reuse that registry/selection model rather than inventing a second proof map.

challenge.scenario: U01 creates only inert fixture JSON and Atlas has no direct test edge.
challenge.finding: Critical route completeness fails despite canonical Known Failure replay having concrete regression tests for quality-infrastructure.
challenge.resolution: Union applicable Known Failure regressionTests into semantic child proof.

challenge.scenario: A non-applicable Known Failure has a convenient regression test.
challenge.finding: Using all registry tests would overstate proof coverage and create false confidence.
challenge.resolution: Resolve proof only from activeFailureIds produced by current child scope.

challenge.scenario: The same regression test is attached to multiple active failures.
challenge.finding: Duplicate proof entries would make route identity unstable and noisy.
challenge.resolution: Deduplicate and lexically sort the canonical proof set.

challenge.scenario: Proof fallback is added to plannedFilePatterns or intendedFiles.
challenge.finding: A read-only evidence surface would become material release scope and could alter decomposition/order.
challenge.resolution: Bind proof only to semanticExecutionRoute.proof and requiredEvidence.proofFiles; assert operations/intendedFiles unchanged.

challenge.scenario: Fresh policy changes applicable Known Failures after the original child manifest was persisted.
challenge.finding: Old requiredEvidence and proof route become stale.
challenge.resolution: Fresh Plan projection recomputes active failures and proof set; reprojection replaces both evidence locations and refreshes identity.

challenge.scenario: Direct Atlas proof and Known Failure regression proof are both empty.
challenge.finding: Fabricating a proof placeholder would violate assurance semantics.
challenge.resolution: Leave proof empty so existing critical validation blocks execution.

challenge.scenario: Template Factory failure is applicable to a child scope.
challenge.finding: Looking only at global knowledge.knownFailures would omit its registered regression tests.
challenge.resolution: Use getAllFailures, the same global+Template Factory registry used by Incremental Replay.

challenge.scenario: Route proof updates but manifest requiredEvidence still contains an old set.
challenge.finding: Child PR context and downstream truth could disagree about required proof.
challenge.resolution: Projection carries canonical proof explicitly; child reprojection writes the same set to manifest requiredEvidence before identity refresh.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require Plan Before Code PASS before implementation.
Implement canonical Known Failure regression proof derivation and bind it to both child route and required evidence.
Add positive, deduplication, non-widening and no-proof fail-closed regression tests.
Require exact-head Knowledge, Plan, Edit-Time, Replay, Release Risk, full tests, TypeScript, build and Completion Truth PASS.
Commit only canonical lifecycle closure metadata and require final exact-head CI PASS.
Merge, verify fresh main CI, then replay the unchanged rehearsal from persisted STALE CAS state.

requirements.requirement: Critical release-unit children without a direct Atlas proof edge must obtain explicit proof only from regression tests of currently applicable Known Failures, with the same proof identity bound to semantic route and manifest required evidence.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Known Failure proof fallback may not widen intended release-unit material scope.
Regression proof from non-applicable Known Failures may not be injected into a child route.

notes: Created from live Failure Intake #1010 after PR #1009 removed stale child metadata drift and exposed the remaining fixture-only semantic proof gap. This commit is plan-only.
